card.title: Don’t Go
card.instruction: Create reasons another player must stay with you. Never directly ask them to stay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you zip your suitcase, let me wrap that jar of jam.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's already wrapped in my jumper.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's your train jumper. We'll need to unpack it and find something else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you haven't tasted it. I'll get a spoon before you decide.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 wrapping keeps B unpacked, A3 invents a jumper need and A5 changes to tasting when B abandons the jar.

relationship.evidence: B2 offers adequate packing and B4 chooses a practical way to leave sooner.

heightening.evidence: B4 solution becomes A5 an unfinished tasting decision, preserving the indirect bid for company.
